name: Soybean Crush Spread Analysis
description: Analyzes the soybean crush spread (gross processing margin) using ZS (soybeans), ZM (soybean meal), and ZL (soybean oil) continuous front-month futures. Computes the board crush in $/bushel, meal and oil component values, meal-to-oil ratio, 20-day rolling average, 1-year z-score, and 1-year percentile rank. Includes seasonality heatmap (year × month) and multi-chart dashboard.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread Analysis
# Board crush ($/bushel) = ZM * 0.024 + ZL * 0.11 - ZS / 100
# ZS: cents/bushel, ZM: $/short ton, ZL: cents/pound
# Conversion: 1 bushel soybeans → 48 lbs meal + 11 lbs oil

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# Primary asset: Soybeans (ZS)
src_zs = market_data_source()()
cont_zs = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(src_zs.o, src_zs.h, src_zs.l, src_zs.c, src_zs.v, src_zs.oi, src_zs.s)
close_zs = cont_zs.c

# Reference: Soybean Meal (ZM)
ref_zm = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
close_zm = ref_zm.c

# Reference: Soybean Oil (ZL)
ref_zl = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
close_zl = ref_zl.c

# ============================================================================
# CRUSH SPREAD COMPONENTS
# ============================================================================

# Meal component value per bushel: ZM ($/ton) * 48 lbs / 2000 lbs per ton
meal_component = close_zm * 0.024

# Oil component value per bushel: ZL (cents/lb) * 11 lbs / 100 cents per dollar
oil_component = close_zl * 0.11

# Board crush spread ($/bushel)
crush_spread = meal_component + oil_component - close_zs / 100

# Meal-to-oil value ratio
meal_oil_ratio = meal_component / oil_component

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING ANALYTICS
# ============================================================================

# 20-day simple moving average of crush spread
crush_ma20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(crush_spread)

# 1-year (252-day) rolling z-score
crush_zscore = zscore(window=252)(crush_spread)

# 1-year (252-day) rolling percentile rank
crush_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(crush_spread)

# 20-day MA of meal-to-oil ratio
ratio_ma20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(meal_oil_ratio)

# ============================================================================
# DATETIME COMPONENTS FOR HEATMAP
# ============================================================================

ts = index()
year_val = datetime_extract(component='year')(ts)
month_val = datetime_extract(component='month')(ts)

# ============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# ============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Table: Key Metrics ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Spread Dashboard',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Crush Spread', 'Indicators'],
        col_headers=['Current', '20d Avg', '1Y Avg'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2, title='Current Crush'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2, title='20d Avg'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2, title='1Y Avg'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, title='Percentile Rank'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='Z-Score'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='Meal/Oil Ratio')
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Key Metrics',
    order=0
)(crush_spread, crush_ma20, crush_spread, crush_pctrank, crush_zscore, meal_oil_ratio)

# --- 2. Crush Spread with 20-day MA ---
xy_lines(
    title='Crush Spread ($/bushel) with 20-Day MA',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='2. Crush Spread',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_spread, crush_ma20))

# --- 3. Meal vs Oil Component Values ---
xy_lines(
    title='Component Values: Meal vs Oil ($/bushel)',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='3. Crush Components',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Meal Component', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Oil Component', color=Color.Amber)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(meal_component, oil_component))

# --- 4. Meal-to-Oil Value Ratio ---
xy_lines(
    title='Meal-to-Oil Value Ratio with 20-Day MA',
    y_axis_label='Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='4. Meal vs Oil Ratio',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Meal/Oil Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(meal_oil_ratio, ratio_ma20))

# --- 5. 1-Year Rolling Z-Score ---
xy_lines(
    title='Crush Spread: 1-Year Rolling Z-Score',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category='5. Z-Score',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='+2σ', color=Color.Error, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='+1σ', color=Color.Warning, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Mean', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.0, title='-1σ', color=Color.Warning, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2σ', color=Color.Error, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_zscore,))

# --- 6. Seasonality Heatmap: Year × Month Average Crush ---
heatmap(
    title='Crush Spread Seasonality (Year × Month Avg $/bu)',
    category='6. Seasonality',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.2f}',
    order=0
)(x=month_val, y=year_val, value=crush_spread)
